newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita Elec develops new DVD optical pickup.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita Elec develops new DVD optical pickup.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd said on Wednesday it had developed a new optical pickup which is compatible with both digital video discs (DVDs) and other optical discs used in computer peripherals.

The new product is not only compatible with DVDs, but also with various types of compact discs and phase-change type rewritable discs, which are used in computer peripherals, a company spokeswoman said.
Commercialisation of the product is still under consideration, the company said in a statement.
